classifications.rationale: The President requests that DOE expedite and prioritize its rulemaking, quantify expected savings, and comply with existing deadlines; DOE will finalize the standards later, and the segment does not dictate their substantive legal terms.
classifications.evidence: the DOE work to complete prior to the applicable deadline those standards that will result in the greatest energy savings
